GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY - FORM 10-K FOR 2016 (hand-built fixture excerpt; see README Part 6)

(In millions; per-share amounts in dollars)

LONG-TERM PRODUCT SERVICE AGREEMENTS. We regularly assess customer credit risk inherent in the carrying amounts of receivables and contract costs and estimated earnings, including the risk that contractual penalties may not be sufficient to offset our accumulated investment in the event of customer termination.

In 2016, changes in estimated profitability on long-term product service agreements increased revenues and earnings by $2.2 billion.

Contract assets include revenues in excess of billings on our long-term product service agreements.
